title: Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink
content:
SOP: Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink (SOP-SEC-001)
DEPARTMENT: Quality and Patient Safety
VERSION: 2.0
ROLES: security, nurse, front_office
PURPOSE: Immediate perimeter lockdown and CCTV inspection on alarm trigger.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Quality and Patient Safety.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-SEC-001 Infant and Pediatric Abduction Code Pink v2.0, Section 4
